jobs.name: 성채
jobs.prompt:
Create ONE simple production pixel-art player aircraft for a 2D indie arcade game. Transparent background. Top-down, flat orthographic overhead. A genuinely small 48x48 LOGICAL PIXEL sprite enlarged nearest-neighbor; draw with big uniform square pixel clusters. The whole machine fits within 42x42 logical pixels with clear margin. EXACTLY FIVE attached short outward-facing turret barrels equally spaced at 12 o'clock, upper right, lower right, lower left, upper left. Simple flat dark gray turret base and a 2-pixel-wide short straight barrel; no elaborate gun mechanism. Readable hull silhouette, a flat small center emblem and a couple of 2-pixel panel notches. 
CRITICAL ART DIRECTION: SIMPLE restrained utilitarian sprite, much less ornate than a detailed painted fantasy spacecraft. 8-12 colors TOTAL, hard flat color fills, maximum 2 shades per hull color plus a single small highlight patch. 1-logical-pixel dark navy outline. 70 percent of armor surface is plain uninterrupted color. Keep only one simple symbol on body and two tiny dark slots, plus broad structural gaps where appropriate. Matte flat painted metal. No gold, no brass, no bronze borders, no trim around plates, no jewelry, no sparkling core, no glowing lights, no bevel rim around every surface, no pipes, no piston joints, no rivets, no tiny circuitry, no gradients, no realistic texture, no complex interlocking armor. A small pale painted marking is enough for identity. Not a featureless flat vector icon: retain a few deliberate square panel cuts, plain gun mount shoulders and 2-tone thickness shading. No text or labels, no drop shadow, no firing effects, no scene, no mockup. Keep colors gently muted, not neon and not gray mud. Reference image is ONLY the game's low-detail pixel terrain/background style; do not draw any terrain. One isolated ship. Do not use the prior ornate gold-framed design.
DESIGN: Compact squat rounded pentagonal hull. Warm muted bone/light gray main armor, dark slate-blue inset center, five simple gray short cylindrical guns on flush perimeter pads. A tiny flat dark chevron marking at center. Five large armor faces separated by just one pixel dark gap. Protected sturdy silhouette, no spikes, no elaborate star-shaped center.
